title: 2D or 3D Trees?
author: Crignog
selftext:
I can't decide on which to use in my game for trees, and possibly buildings as well. Any suggestions?

https://preview.redd.it/p243ryuqgnrh1.png?width=1914&format=png&auto=webp&s=82244b2aa2fa9d557389fe930e5efe2d07efb5cb

https://preview.redd.it/eay1othxgnrh1.png?width=1912&format=png&auto=webp&s=2dbd35e07518b562192da2e90d82549d2cf46bcb

comments.author: RUSuper
comments.body: 3D for sure, maybe try adding ink shader on the outlines of them to make them stick out a bit more. 2D looks out of place here.

replies.author: Crignog
replies.body: I think I agree. I had a comment on a different post about swapping to sprites for trees is all haha! Thanks. I'll have a look at outlines! :)

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body: I agree 3D, bur needs a texture or shader over them to blend in with the style

replies.author: Crignog
replies.body: Yeah they are super barebones, okay thank you!

comments.author: daddywookie
comments.body: Why not both. 3D for up close with lighting, shaders etc and then at distance go to billboard sprites for performance.

replies.author: Crignog
replies.body: Using billboards in the background is definitely on my list, more for the up close shots

comments.author: Outrageous-Issue9722
comments.body: 3d but less bright in my opinion
